examName: Designing and Building Integrated AI Solutions in Copilot Studio
note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for AB-620. Three defects on the published page are recorded here so nobody 'corrects' them from the page later. (1) The study guide carries TWO 'Study resources' sections with different content, and the first one's 'Get trained' link points at AI-900's page rather than AB-620's; the second block links correctly. (2) The page heading reads 'Designing and Building Integrated AI Solutions in Copilot Studio' while the page description reads 'Designing and Building Integrated AI Agent Solutions in Copilot Studio' — the heading is used here. The credential earned is 'AI Agent Builder', which is a third distinct name and is what catalog.json carries. (3) Like SC-500, AI-300, AZ-802, AI-200 and AB-410, the guide carries no 'Skills measured as of <date>' line. This is the third Microsoft page defect the project has found, after SC-300's self-contradicting weights and DP-800's wrong heading.
